manifest.name: dsh-ncm-plugin
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapping the NetEase Cloud Music CLI (ncm-cli).

bundle.text:
# DSH bundle patch: inserts the plugin row into a profile roster.
# Install: dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:king-bcolor/dsh-ncm-plugin
- insert:
    - id: ncm
      name: dsh-ncm-plugin

readme.text:
> **中文文档**：[README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that wraps the [ncm-cli](https://github.com/Davied-H/ncm-cli) NetEase Cloud Music command-line tool as model-callable tools.

`dsh-ncm-plugin` exposes NetEase Cloud Music CLI capabilities to DSH agents: account status, playlists, songs, lyrics, playable URLs, daily recommendations, play records, search, and playlist management/cleanup — all through structured, JSON-backed tools.

- Account: login status, current user, version.
- Playlists: list/show/create/add/remove/rename/tags/desc/delete.
- Playlist tidy: inspect, filter, diff, apply, move, duplicates.
- Songs: metadata, lyrics, playable URL resolution, desktop playback.
- Discovery: daily recommendations, weekly/all play records.
- Search: suggestions, songs, playlists.
- Safe by default: destructive writes require explicit confirmation.
- JSON-first output for agents, readable text rendering for the UI.
- Built-in Web Settings panel: every tool is exposed as an auto-generated
  form (account, playlists, tidy, search, song/lyric/URL, recommendations).

- Ask the agent "what's in my playlist 490155105?"
- Search for songs and add them to a playlist.
- Clean up duplicate songs in a large playlist.
- Look up lyrics and playable URLs.
- Check daily recommendations and play history.

See [docs/用例目录/README.md](./docs/用例目录/README.md) for the full command/use-case/parameter catalog (Chinese).

- Node.js 22+, `dsh` CLI installed (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`).
- No preinstalled `ncm` CLI is required. The plugin auto-downloads the
  platform release binary into `$DSH_HOME/bin` on first tool run, or when you
  click **Install/update ncm** in the UI. Download order: `ghfast.top` →
  `gh-proxy.com` → GitHub official, so mainland-China networks use mirrors
  first. Playwright driver downloads use `npmmirror.com` by default.

Install into the **web** profile so the browser UI is available:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:king-bcolor/dsh-ncm-plugin

readme.section: This package has no prepare/build step, so no pnpm build permission is needed.
readme.text:
```
For headless/agent-only use, install into a headless profile the same way.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/king-bcolor/dsh-ncm-plugin.git
cd dsh-ncm-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Start the browser UI:
```bash
dsh web
```
The first tool call downloads ncm automatically; you can also open
**Settings → NetEase Cloud Music** and click **Install/update ncm**, then
**Log in to NetEase Cloud Music**.
Open **Settings → NetEase Cloud Music**. The panel exposes every ncm tool as a
form: account status, playlist browse/manage, tidy, search, song/lyric/URL,
recommendations, and records. Results are shown as readable text with a raw
JSON toggle.

You can still ask the agent in the same web session:
```bash

Use ncm_me to check my NetEase Cloud Music login.
Search NetEase Cloud Music for the song "晴天" and show the first 5 results.
```
```yaml

readme.section: profile cordis.patch.yml or plugin row config
readme.text:
- id: ncm
  name: dsh-ncm-plugin
  config:
    ncmBin: ncm
    ncmInstallDir: $DSH_HOME/bin
    configDir: $DSH_HOME/ncm-config
    autoInstall: true
    ncmDownloadBaseUrl: https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/Davied-H/ncm-cli/releases/latest/download
    playwrightDownloadHost: https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/playwright
    timeoutMs: 30000
    confirmWrites: true
```

TDD is mandatory for this project. The workspace is plain ESM JavaScript with
`node:test`; there is no build step:
```bash
npm test          # red first, then implement until green
```

Local checkout quick start (no system ncm required):
```bash
./setup.sh
./start.sh
```
This creates a writable `.dsh-home`, bootstraps `ncm` into
`.dsh-home/bin`, installs the plugin into the web profile, and starts the UI.

> **English README**：[README.md](./README.md)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，把 [ncm-cli](https://github.com/Davied-H/ncm-cli) 网易云音乐命令行工具封装为模型可调用的工具集。
`dsh-ncm-plugin` 把网易云音乐命令行能力暴露给 DSH Agent：账号状态、歌单、歌曲、歌词、播放地址、每日推荐、播放记录、搜索、歌单管理与整理，全部通过结构化 JSON 工具调用完成。

- 账号：登录状态、当前用户、版本。
- 歌单：列表/详情/创建/加歌/移除/重命名/标签/描述/删除。
- 歌单整理：inspect、filter、diff、apply、move、duplicates。
- 歌曲：元数据、歌词、播放地址解析、桌面端播放。
- 发现：每日推荐、最近一周/全部播放记录。
- 搜索：搜索建议、歌曲、歌单。
- 默认安全：删除/移除等危险写操作必须显式确认。
- Agent 优先使用 JSON 输出，UI 提供可读文本渲染。
- 内置 Web Settings 面板：全部工具以自动生成表单暴露（账号、歌单、整理、搜索、歌曲/歌词/URL、推荐与记录）。

- 问 Agent：“我的歌单 490155105 里有什么？”
- 搜索歌曲并加入歌单。
- 清理大歌单里的重复歌曲。
- 查歌词和可播放地址。
- 查看每日推荐和播放记录。

完整命令/用例/参数目录见 [docs/用例目录/README.md](./docs/用例目录/README.md)。

- Node.js 22+，已安装 `dsh` CLI（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）。
- **不需要预先安装 `ncm` CLI**。插件会在首次执行工具、或点击 UI 中的
  **安装/更新 ncm** 时，自动下载当前平台 Release 二进制到 `$DSH_HOME/bin`。
  国内网络默认按 `ghfast.top` → `gh-proxy.com` → GitHub 官方 顺序回退；
  Playwright driver 默认使用 `npmmirror.com` 镜像。

安装到 **web** profile，浏览器 UI 才可用：
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:king-bcolor/dsh-ncm-plugin

readme.section: 本插件无 prepare/构建步骤，因此无需额外授予 pnpm 构建许可。
readme.text:
```
仅作 Agent/无头使用时，安装到 headless profile 即可。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/king-bcolor/dsh-ncm-plugin.git
cd dsh-ncm-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

启动浏览器 UI：
```bash
dsh web
```
首次执行工具会自动下载 ncm；也可以打开 **设置 → 网易云音乐**，先点
**安装/更新 ncm**，再点 **登录网易云**。
打开 **设置 → 网易云音乐**。面板把全部 ncm 工具暴露为表单：账号状态、歌单浏览/管理、整理、搜索、歌曲/歌词/URL、推荐与记录。结果显示为可读文本，并带原始 JSON 切换。

在同一个 Web 会话中仍可直接对话调用：
```bash

用 ncm_me 检查我的网易云音乐登录状态。
在网易云音乐搜索歌曲“晴天”，展示前 5 条结果。
```

```yaml
- id: ncm
  name: dsh-ncm-plugin
  config:
    ncmBin: ncm

本项目全程 TDD，使用纯 ESM JavaScript + `node:test`，无需构建步骤：
```bash
npm test          # 先写失败测试，再实现到通过
```

本地 checkout 快速启动（无需系统 ncm）：
```bash
./setup.sh
./start.sh
```
脚本会创建可写的 `.dsh-home`，把 `ncm` 安装到 `.dsh-home/bin`，把插件装进
web profile，并启动 Web UI。
